theme: Graphite GPU and Nano Server fonts
highlights_headline: This development snapshot adds Graphite GPU backends (Vulkan, Metal, Dawn) and FreeType font support for Nano Server.
highlights_body: The new Graphite rendering engine gains complete bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn via a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package. Nano Server gains FreeType-based font rendering. Memory safety fixes land for SKPixmap and SKImage, and performance improvements reduce allocations in SKData streaming, string encoding, and runtime effect uniforms.

bullets.lead: Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn
bullets.detail: New bindings expose the Graphite rendering backend across all three GPU APIs — Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn — giving consumers access to the next-generation Skia renderer.
SKImage and SKSurface gain a backend-neutral RequestReadPixels API for asynchronous GPU-to-CPU pixel transfer without blocking the GPU pipeline.
A new convenience package wraps Vulkan via the Silk.NET bindings, simplifying Vulkan context setup for SkiaSharp applications.

bullets.lead: Use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* fixed
bullets.detail: The root pixel source was not kept alive through the derived pixmap's lifetime; native memory could be freed while still in use.

bullets.lead: Memory leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path fixed
bullets.detail: A CoTaskMem pixel buffer was leaked when the SKImage raster creation path failed; the buffer is now correctly freed on failure.

bullets.lead: FreeType font support on Nano Server
bullets.detail: Nano Server, which has no GDI or DirectWrite, can now load and render fonts using FreeType, resolving a long-standing gap for containerized Windows workloads.

bullets.lead: Containerized test coverage: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server
bullets.detail: CI test legs now validate SkiaSharp on container-hosted Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Windows Nano Server targets, catching portability regressions earlier.

bullets.lead: Upstream Skia m151 stability patches applied
bullets.detail: Multiple upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix merges keep the bundled engine current with Google's stable branch.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server, resolving font rendering in GDI-free container environments
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Optimized the Windows native build by initializing the MSVC environment once per build instead of once per step
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Implemented full Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn
